title: the hall: its sign sits at its ring, gen has room, the empty line is quiet
why: Critic on the hall (3 of 5, P1 and P2 on this job): the hall sign sat about 30 room units below its ring and read as detached; gen sat 16px from how it ended; the hall is empty was a title size line floating in the void. His words stay, the hall is empty. The sign moves under the ring, gen gets a 32px gutter, the line becomes a quiet 20px left aligned row. The plaque itself keeps its size, the bay between the pier and the lift holds three at this size.
now: The hall sign sits right under the ring by the wall. Watch for: nothing else changes.
